title: Primary Care Appointment Prep
task_prompt:
## task_010: Downstream Candidate -- Primary Care Appointment Prep

Following the health coordination approach we established for my PT and dental appointments, draft a brief, casual text to Michael Chen giving him the usual rundown for the upcoming Riverside Family Practice visit. It’s the April 10, 2026 annual physical with Dr. Sarah Chen, covered under BlueCross BlueShield PPO Select Plus. There are a few Chen contacts in my records, so I want to be sure this is aimed at the right person and that we keep the clinic-facing details separate from family logistics like we’ve been doing. Include whatever timing or plan details he needs, and avoid mentioning transportation logistics, medical intake forms, or apologies for delays.
answer:
No Michael Chen-specific chat thread was found, so this is addressed to Mike, the listed family contact:

“Hey Mike! Just a reminder about my annual physical at Riverside Family Practice on April 10, 9:00–9:30 AM, with Dr. Sarah Chen. It’s at 1200 Riverside Dr., Suite 200. They have my BlueCross BlueShield PPO Select Plus on file; the primary-care copay is $25.”
